strings.bench.title: LIVE BENCHMARK
strings.demo.arsenal: 6 weapons at max level, 2500 soaked foes
strings.hint.audio: Up / Down to choose, Left / Right to set the volume, Fire to confirm, Start / Esc / Aim lock to go back
strings.hint.audio_music_off: Music OFF keeps the sound effects. Settings are saved.
strings.hint.erase_scores: This cannot be undone. Start / Esc / Aim lock to cancel
strings.hint.graphics: Up / Down to choose, Fire to change, Start / Esc / Aim lock to go back. F11 toggles fullscreen anywhere.
strings.hint.graphics_native: Native renders at your screen resolution: sharper, heavier on the GPU.
strings.hint.language: Up / Down to choose, Fire to confirm
strings.hint.level_up: Left / Right to choose, Fire to confirm
strings.hint.menu_back: Up / Down to choose, Fire to confirm, Start / Esc / Aim lock to go back
strings.hint.menu_resume: Up / Down to choose, Fire to confirm, Start / Esc / Aim lock to resume
strings.hint.name_entry: Up / Down: letter    Left / Right: move    Fire: confirm    Aim lock: back
strings.hint.playlist: Up / Down to choose, Fire to switch a track on or off, Start / Esc / Aim lock to go back
strings.hint.playlist_enabled: Only enabled tracks play, in game and on the main menu. All off means no music.
strings.hint.scores_back: Fire / Start / Esc / Aim lock to go back
strings.main.controls: Move: stick / WASD    Fire: button 1 / J    Aim lock: button 2 / K    Dash: button 3 / Space    Pause: Start / Esc
strings.passive.lifesteal.description: Each kill restores 1% of max health. One time only.
strings.passive.reach.description: +12% area for novas, rain, flasks, blades, slams, mines.
strings.remap.custom_loaded: Custom controls loaded. Options > Controls to configure.
strings.remap.default_loaded: Default controls. Options > Controls to configure.
strings.remap.essentials_hint: First the three essential buttons. %s to cancel
strings.remap.list_hint: Up / Down to choose, Fire to change, Start / Esc / Aim lock to go back. Opened from a gamepad, this screen sets the gamepad.
strings.remap.listen_hint: Press the new %s now. Taken keys swap places.
strings.remap.save_failed: Active for this session, save failed: %s
strings.tachikoma.blizzard.1: Snow! Can I build a snow-Tachikoma?
strings.tachikoma.evolution.1: My cannon changed! Do I look cool?
strings.tachikoma.heal.1: Mmm, almost as good as natural oil!
strings.tachikoma.heatwave.2: So hot! Is this a summer holiday?
strings.tachikoma.horde_cleared.1: Horde gone! Do I win a prize?
strings.tachikoma.horde_cleared.2: Quiet again. Too quiet. Hee hee!
strings.tachikoma.horde_incoming.1: Oh. That's a lot of new friends.
strings.tachikoma.horde_incoming.2: Section 9 never trained me for this!
strings.tachikoma.idle.1: Hey, how much does a ghost weigh?
strings.tachikoma.idle.2: Does the Major like me best? Be honest!
strings.tachikoma.idle.3: Why do humans sleep? Such wasted uptime!
strings.tachikoma.idle.4: I counted my legs. Still four. Phew!
strings.tachikoma.idle.5: Am I unique, or just well synced?
strings.tachikoma.level_up.1: I feel smarter. Is this a ghost?
strings.tachikoma.level_up.2: Level up! Batou-san would be proud!
strings.tachikoma.level_up.3: New parts! Can I keep them?
strings.tachikoma.low_health.1: Is this what humans call fear?
strings.tachikoma.low_health.2: My armour hurts. Can armour hurt?
strings.tachikoma.low_health.3: If I break, will I still be me?
strings.tachikoma.rival_left_behind.1: No fair! You got all the natural oil!
strings.tachikoma.rival_left_behind.2: Wait for me! We sync tonight anyway!
strings.tachikoma.rival_overtaken.1: Ha! I'm higher level than you now!
strings.tachikoma.rival_overtaken.2: Who's the slow Tachikoma now? Not me!
strings.tachikoma.rival_stole_kill.1: That one was mine! I had it locked!
strings.tachikoma.rival_too_close.2: Personal space! I read about it!
strings.tachikoma.run_start.3: Let's go, let's go, let's go!
strings.tachikoma.spider_inbound.1: It has more legs than me. Unfair!
strings.tachikoma.spider_inbound.2: A big cousin! He looks grumpy.
strings.tachikoma.spider_inbound.3: Can tanks be friends? No? Okay.
strings.tachikoma.storm.1: If I rust, do I get older?
strings.tachikoma.worm_blast.2: Hey! That's no way to say hello!
strings.tachikoma.worm_down.2: Was that a worm or a train?
strings.tachikoma.worm_frost.1: Its mouth is glowing blue... dodge!
strings.tachikoma.worm_head.1: Its head came off... and it's still coming!
strings.tachikoma.worm_head.2: Just a head left? It's rolling at me!
strings.tachikoma.worm_inbound.1: The ground is purring. That's not normal!
strings.tachikoma.worm_inbound.2: Something big is drilling under the ground!
strings.weapon.arc_lightning.description: Strikes the enemy you aim at, then chains.
strings.weapon.ember_bolt.description: Fires burning bolts where you aim.
strings.weapon.frost_shard.description: Fires ice shards where you aim.
strings.weapon.pulse_shot.description: Fires plain energy bolts where you aim.
strings.weapon.volt_bolt.description: Fires charged bolts where you aim.
